entities.summary: Nusli Neville Wadia is an Indian businessman. He is the chairman of the Wadia Group, a conglomerate with interests in textiles, aviation, chemicals, and real estate. His father, Neville Wadia, was a prominent businessman, and his mother, Dina Wadia, was the daughter of Muhammad Ali Jinnah, the founder and first Governor-General of Pakistan.
